nodes.label: ADR 0180: GLUE's own playlists kept in Engine DJ's GLUE folder, both ways
nodes.rationale: GLUE's playlists need to sync with Engine DJ's in a GLUE folder, enabling users to manage playlists in both directions. Uses three-way merge from ADR 0171 on a separate playlist set. User chose both-ways sync over GLUE-only master approach. Keeps playlists in Engine DJ separate from GLUE-owned playlists.

nodes.label: ADR 0178: DJ playlists stay in the DJ collection
nodes.rationale: Engine DJ's playlists were being stored in GLUE's Playlists folder and synced both ways. This was reverted: DJ app playlists stay in the DJ app's collection; imports into GLUE are one-way copies. Only GLUE's own playlists go to Engine DJ in a GLUE folder.

nodes.label: ADR 0179: Engine DJ edited in the DJ collection
nodes.rationale: Engine DJ playlists in the DJ collection can be edited from GLUE. Changes show at once with pending indicator. GLUE Home writes when Engine DJ closes, after backup. Song info syncs both ways.
